name: No Plastic
line: Against plastic. The name is the whole demand.
deck: Two words, and no ambiguity about what is being asked. What we cannot yet say is what it did — where it ran, who moved, what stopped.

holes.what: A demand this clear should have a record behind it, and we hold none: no year, no target, no outcome.
holes.unlocks: When it ran and what it changed. A refusal counts as an outcome.

holes.what: We do not say whether this is about a ban, a substitution, or a shop. Those are three different campaigns.
holes.unlocks: Which of the three it is.
